Card.signature: Card(children: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock | ListBlock | FollowUpBlock | SectionBlock | Tabs | Carousel | RouteMap | RouteStops | RouteSuggestions | BicycleExplorer | DistributionExplorer | EconomyExplorer | DroneExplorer | DroneMarket | MontyHall | RetroGame | BillLineItem | BillSplitter | SavingsCalculator | RecipeIngredient | RecipeStep | MenuDish | RecipePlanner | WardrobePiece | WardrobeOutfit | PackingRule | WardrobePlanner | TripStop | RoadTripPlanner | ColorSwatch | ColorRegion | GuideStep | GridOption | GridLayout | RecolorableScene | IllustratedStepGuide | EditableGrid | AssemblyGuide | RoomColorPreview | OrigamiGuide | GardenPlanner | BikeRepair | SceneShape | SceneDrawing | DiagramPart | ExplodedDiagram | RangeControl | ChoiceControl | ValueDisplay | Contribution | ContributionChart | KnowledgeCheck | InteractivePanel | InteractiveGroup)[], sources?: {url?: string, title: string, sourceName: string}[])
Card.description: Root response container. Compose clear text, visualizations, interactive tools and everyday planning components. Avoid redundant headings when an interactive component already has a title.

CardHeader.description: Header with optional title and subtitle

TextContent.description: Text block. Supports markdown. Optional size: "small" | "default" | "large" | "small-heavy" | "large-heavy".

MarkDownRenderer.description: Renders markdown text with optional container variant

Callout.signature: Callout(variant: "info" | "warning" | "error" | "success" | "neutral", title: string, description: string, visible?: $binding<boolean>)
Callout.description: Callout banner. Optional visible is a reactive $boolean — auto-dismisses after 3s by setting $visible to false.

TextCallout.description: Text callout with variant, title, and description

Image.description: Image with alt text and optional URL

ImageGallery.signature: ImageGallery(images: {src: string, alt?: string, details?: string}[])
ImageGallery.description: Gallery grid of images with modal preview

Table.description: Data table — column-oriented. Each Col holds its own data array.

Col.description: Column definition — holds label + data array

BarChart.signature: BarChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "grouped" | "stacked", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, height?: number)
BarChart.description: Vertical bars; use for comparing values across categories with one or more series

LineChart.signature: LineChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "linear" | "natural" | "step", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, height?: number)
LineChart.description: Lines over categories; use for trends and continuous data over time

AreaChart.signature: AreaChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "linear" | "natural" | "step", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, height?: number)
AreaChart.description: Filled area under lines; use for cumulative totals or volume trends over time

RadarChart.description: Spider/web chart; use for comparing multiple variables across one or more entities

HorizontalBarChart.signature: HorizontalBarChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "grouped" | "stacked", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string)
HorizontalBarChart.description: Horizontal bars; prefer when category labels are long or for ranked lists

PieChart.signature: PieChart(labels: string[], values: number[], variant?: "pie" | "donut", appearance?: "circular" | "semiCircular")
PieChart.description: Circular slices; use plucked arrays: PieChart(data.categories, data.values)

RadialChart.description: Radial bars; use plucked arrays: RadialChart(data.categories, data.values)

SingleStackedBarChart.description: Single horizontal stacked bar; use plucked arrays: SingleStackedBarChart(data.categories, data.values)

Slice.description: One slice with label and numeric value

ScatterChart.signature: ScatterChart(datasets: ScatterSeries[], xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string)
ScatterChart.description: X/Y scatter plot; use for correlations, distributions, and clustering

Point.signature: Point(x: number, y: number, z?: number)

Form.signature: Form(name: string, buttons: Buttons, fields?: FormControl[])
Form.description: Form container with fields and explicit action buttons

FormControl.signature: FormControl(label: string, input: Input | TextArea | Select | DatePicker | Slider | CheckBoxGroup | RadioGroup | Chips | OptionCards, hint?: string)
FormControl.description: Field with label, input component, and optional hint text

Input.signature: Input(name: string, placeholder?: string, type?: "text" | "email" | "password" | "number" | "url", rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<string>)

TextArea.signature: TextArea(name: string, placeholder?: string, rows?: number, rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<string>)

Select.signature: Select(name: string, items: SelectItem[], placeholder?: string, rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<string>, size?: "small" | "medium" | "large")

DatePicker.signature: DatePicker(name: string, mode?: "single" | "range", rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<any>)

Slider.signature: Slider(name: string, variant: "continuous" | "discrete", min: number, max: number, step?: number, defaultValue?: number[], label?: string, rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<number[]>)
Slider.description: Numeric slider input; supports continuous and discrete (stepped) variants

CheckBoxGroup.signature: CheckBoxGroup(name: string, items: CheckBoxItem[], rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<Record<string, boolean>>)

CheckBoxItem.signature: CheckBoxItem(label: string, description: string, name: string, defaultChecked?: boolean)

RadioGroup.signature: RadioGroup(name: string, items: RadioItem[], defaultValue?: string, rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<string>)

RadioItem.signature: RadioItem(label: string, description: string, value: string)

SwitchGroup.signature: SwitchGroup(name: string, items: SwitchItem[], variant?: "clear" | "card" | "sunk", value?: $binding<Record<string, boolean>>)

SwitchItem.signature: SwitchItem(label?: string, description?: string, name: string, defaultChecked?: boolean)

Button.signature: Button(label: string, action?: ActionExpression, variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "tertiary", type?: "normal" | "destructive", size?: "extra-small" | "small" | "medium" | "large")

ListBlock.description: A list of items with number or image indicators. Each item can optionally have an action. size small renders a compact list.

ListItem.signature: ListItem(title: string, subtitle?: string, image?: {src: string, alt: string}, actionLabel?: string, action?: ActionExpression)
ListItem.description: Item in a ListBlock — displays a title with an optional subtitle and image. When action is provided, the item becomes clickable.

FollowUpBlock.description: List of clickable follow-up suggestions placed at the end of a response

FollowUpItem.description: Clickable follow-up suggestion — when clicked, sends text as user message

SectionBlock.description: Collapsible accordion sections. Auto-opens sections as they stream in. Use SectionItem for each section.

SectionItem.signature: SectionItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock | ListBlock | FollowUpBlock | Tabs | Accordion)[])
SectionItem.description: Section with a label and collapsible content — used inside SectionBlock

TabItem.signature: TabItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock | ListBlock | FollowUpBlock | Accordion)[])
TabItem.description: value is unique id, trigger is tab label, content is array of components

AccordionItem.signature: AccordionItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock | ListBlock | FollowUpBlock)[])
AccordionItem.description: value is unique id, trigger is section title

StepsItem.description: title and details text for one step

Carousel.signature: Carousel(children: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock | ListBlock | FollowUpBlock)[][], variant?: "card" | "sunk")

TagBlock.description: tags is an array of strings; optional size sm | md | lg

Tag.signature: Tag(text: string, icon?: Icon, size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg", variant?: "neutral" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger")
Tag.description: Styled tag/badge with optional Icon and variant

EntityList.signature: EntityList(rows?: {left: string, right: string, rightVariant?: "text" | "number"}[], size?: "small" | "default", header?: {left: string, right: string, rightVariant?: "text" | "number"}, footer?: {left: string, right: string, rightVariant?: "text" | "number"})
EntityList.description: Two-column key/value rows (left label, right value). size 'default' supports optional header and footer rows; rightVariant 'number' uses tabular numbers.

InlineHeader.description: Compact section heading with an optional one-line description, for use inside cards.

Icon.description: A lucide icon by kebab-case name (e.g. 'circle-check'). Optional category picks a topical fallback when the name doesn't resolve.

IconButton.signature: IconButton(name: string, icon: Icon, action?: ActionExpression, variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "tertiary", size?: "extra-small" | "small" | "medium" | "large", shape?: "square" | "circle")
IconButton.description: Icon-only button. name is the accessible label and the action label; icon is an Icon; action fires on click.

EditableTable.signature: EditableTable(name?: string, columns?: {type: "text" | "number" | "date-single" | "select" | "url", key?: string, header?: string, width?: number, options?: {value: string, label: string}[]}[], data?: {id: string, values: (string | number)[]}[])
EditableTable.description: Spreadsheet-like table whose cells the user can edit inline (text, number, url, date, select columns); edits are saved back as a form field

ChipItem.signature: ChipItem(value: string, label: string, icon?: Icon, disabled?: boolean)
ChipItem.description: A single selectable chip inside a Chips group, with a value, label and optional icon.

Chips.signature: Chips(name: string, type?: "single" | "multiple", items?: ChipItem[], rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, defaultValue?: string | string[])
Chips.description: A form field of compact selectable chips for choosing one or many short options; the selection is stored under `name`.

OptionCard.signature: OptionCard(value: string, title: string, subtitle?: string, topContent?: Icon | Image, disabled?: boolean)
OptionCard.description: A single selectable card inside an OptionCards group, with a value, title, optional subtitle and an optional Icon or Image on top.

OptionCards.signature: OptionCards(name: string, type?: "single" | "multiple", items?: OptionCard[], rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, defaultValue?: string | string[])
OptionCards.description: A form field of selectable cards (title, optional subtitle, optional icon or image) laid out in a responsive grid for choosing one or many options; the selection is stored under `name`.

Text.signature: Text(variant?: "text" | "number", value: string, subtext?: string, subtextVariant?: "text" | "number" | "metric", size?: "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg")
Text.description: Plain text line with optional subtext. variant 'number' uses tabular number styling; subtextVariant 'metric' colors a leading +/- subtext green/red.

BoldText.signature: BoldText(variant?: "text" | "number", value: string, subtext?: string, subtextVariant?: "text" | "number" | "metric", size?: "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg")
BoldText.description: Emphasized (bold) text line with optional subtext. variant 'number' uses tabular number styling; subtextVariant 'metric' colors a leading +/- subtext green/red.

IconText.signature: IconText(icon: Icon, iconVariant?: "neutral" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "inverted" | "filled" | "soft", iconSize?: "xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl" | "sm" | "md" | "lg", title: string, subtitle?: string, bold?: boolean, layout?: "horizontal" | "vertical")
IconText.description: An icon badge with a title and optional subtitle, laid out horizontally or vertically. iconVariant sets the badge color.

ImageText.signature: ImageText(src: string, alt?: string, title: string, subtitle?: string, bold?: boolean, layout?: "horizontal" | "vertical", imageSize?: number)
ImageText.description: A small square image (thumbnail/avatar) with a title and optional subtitle. src must be a real image URL.

ImageTextLarge.signature: ImageTextLarge(src: string, alt?: string, title: string, subtitle?: string, bold?: boolean)
ImageTextLarge.description: A full-width banner image above a bold title and optional subtitle. src must be a real image URL.

MetricIndicatorInline.signature: MetricIndicatorInline(value: string, subtext?: string, trend?: {direction: "up" | "down", value: number})
MetricIndicatorInline.description: Headline metric value with an optional +/- percentage trend and subtext, all on one line.

MetricIndicatorWithStrikethrough.signature: MetricIndicatorWithStrikethrough(value: string, subtext?: string, previousValue?: string, trend?: {direction: "up" | "down", value: number})
MetricIndicatorWithStrikethrough.description: Headline metric value with an optional struck-through previousValue, a +/- percentage trend, and subtext below.

SnippetCardItem.signature: SnippetCardItem(id?: string, lhs: IconText | ImageText, rhs?: Text | BoldText)
SnippetCardItem.description: One row-style snippet card: a label on the left (IconText or ImageText) and an optional value on the right (Text or BoldText).

SnippetCardBlock.signature: SnippetCardBlock(items: SnippetCardItem[], layout?: "grid", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string)
SnippetCardBlock.description: A responsive grid of compact label/value cards (2 per row) for showing several short facts side by side; optionally clickable with a shared action.

OverviewCardItem.signature: OverviewCardItem(id?: string, top: IconText | ImageText | Text, bottom?: MetricIndicatorInline)
OverviewCardItem.description: One overview card: a heading slot at the top (IconText, ImageText or Text) and an optional MetricIndicatorInline at the bottom.

OverviewCardBlock.signature: OverviewCardBlock(items: OverviewCardItem[], layout?: "grid" | "carousel", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string)
OverviewCardBlock.description: A grid or horizontal carousel of compact overview cards, each with a heading (icon/image/text) on top and an inline metric below; optionally clickable with a shared action.

ContextCardItem.signature: ContextCardItem(id?: string, title: string | Tag, body?: string, bgColor?: "gray", bgImageSrc?: string, bgImageAlt?: string)
ContextCardItem.description: A single card inside a ContextCardBlock: a title (plain string or Tag), an optional markdown body, and an optional gray tint or background image.

ContextCardBlock.signature: ContextCardBlock(items: ContextCardItem[], layout?: "grid" | "carousel", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string)
ContextCardBlock.description: A grid or carousel of compact tinted context cards (title or tag plus a short bold body); an optional action makes every card clickable.

CompositeCardItem.signature: CompositeCardItem(id?: string, header?: IconText | ImageText | ImageTextLarge | Text | Image, body?: (Text | BoldText | MetricIndicatorInline | IconText | Image | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | ListBlock | TagBlock | EntityList)[], footer?: {price?: BoldText | MetricIndicatorWithStrikethrough, button?: Button})
CompositeCardItem.description: A single card inside a CompositeCardBlock: an optional header (icon/image/text), a stack of body elements (text, metrics, charts, lists, tags), and an optional price/button footer.

CompositeCardBlock.signature: CompositeCardBlock(items: CompositeCardItem[], layout?: "grid" | "carousel", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string)
CompositeCardBlock.description: A two-per-row grid or carousel of rich cards, each with an optional header, stacked body content (text, metrics, charts, lists, tags) and a price/button footer; an optional action makes every card clickable.

VisualCardItem.signature: VisualCardItem(body: BoldText, id?: string, bgImageSrc?: string, tag?: Tag, bgImageAlt?: string)
VisualCardItem.description: A single photo-first card inside a VisualCardBlock: a BoldText body panel, an optional Tag, and a background image (bgImageSrc must be a real URL; bgImageAlt is its alt text).

VisualCardBlock.signature: VisualCardBlock(items: VisualCardItem[], layout?: "grid" | "carousel", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string)
VisualCardBlock.description: A grid or carousel of photo-first cards: a full-bleed background image with a tag on top and a bold text panel at the bottom; an optional action makes every card clickable.

RouteMap.description: Interactive map that plots RouteStop items in visiting order with a walking path. Always reuse the SAME RouteStop references in RouteStops below it.

RouteStops.description: Photo cards for each RouteStop (real photos, story, tips, remove-from-route toggle).

RouteSuggestions.description: Optional extra stops the user can add to the route with one tap (adds a pin to RouteMap and a card to RouteStops). Use 2 stops that are NOT already in the route.

RouteStop.signature: RouteStop(name: string, wikiTitle: string, lat: number, lng: number, time: string, story: string, beforeYouGo: string, category?: string, id?: string)
RouteStop.description: One stop on a route. wikiTitle is the exact English Wikipedia article title (used to load real photos). lat/lng are decimal coordinates. time e.g. '9:00 · 1 hr'. story: 1-2 sentences of history. beforeYouGo: one practical tip. Optional category groups the map, e.g. 'Landmarks', 'Museums' or 'Neighborhoods'. Optional id distinguishes repeated visits or stops with identical names in a route.

BicycleExplorer.description: Interactive side-view seven-speed bicycle with selectable Frame, Wheels, Drivetrain, Brakes and Cockpit systems, explanations and moving pedals. Use for explaining bicycle mechanics.

DistributionExplorer.description: Interactive central limit theorem simulation with sample size, population distributions, live histograms and sampling controls. Use for explaining statistics and the CLT.

EconomyExplorer.description: Interactive GDP explainer with adjustable consumer spending, investment, government spending and net exports. Values are illustrative, not current economic data.

DroneExplorer.description: Interactive drone photography composition explainer: camera tilt, altitude, illustrated landscape and thirds grid.

DroneMarket.description: Interactive drone photography market overview with photo categories, illustrative growth chart, comparison KPIs, revenue sliders and business table. Example figures are not live market data.

MontyHall.description: Playable Monty Hall probability demonstration. Pick one of three doors, switch or stay, and simulate 1000 games.

RetroGame.description: Playable retro handheld console with Snake, Breakout and Pong, real collision physics, scoring, keyboard and touch directional controls, pause and restart. game selects the initial game. Retro beige handheld housing and green pixel screen.

BillLineItem.signature: BillLineItem(name: string, amount: number, people: number[])
BillLineItem.description: An expense for BillSplitter. amount is in the selected currency's main unit. people contains zero-based indexes into the splitter's people array; assign at least one person when splitting by item.

BillSplitter.signature: BillSplitter(title: string, currency: string, people: string[], items: BillLineItem[], taxPercent: $binding<number>, tipPercent: $binding<number>, description?: string, splitMethod?: "items" | "equal", tipBasis?: "subtotal" | "after-tax", peopleLabel?: string, itemsLabel?: string, subtotalLabel?: string)
BillSplitter.description: Compose editable bills, trips or shared expenses from BillLineItem refs and named people. Currency-aware exact splitting, per-item or equal allocation, editable tax/tip and copyable shares. taxPercent and tipPercent accept $state bindings so controls can share state with the response. Optional labels adapt the copy to the expense type.

SavingsCalculator.signature: SavingsCalculator(title: string, currency: string, initialSavings: $binding<number>, monthlyContribution: $binding<number>, years: $binding<number>, annualReturn: $binding<number>, description?: string, contributionTiming?: "start" | "end", annualContributionGrowth?: number)
SavingsCalculator.description: A configurable projection for any savings goal, currency, balance, monthly deposit and horizon. Numeric inputs accept $state bindings. Calculates monthly compounding with optional start/end-of-month deposits and an annual contribution increase. Includes zero and negative return scenarios; hypothetical projections are not guaranteed.

RecipeIngredient.signature: RecipeIngredient(name: string, quantity: number, unit: string, scaling?: "proportional" | "whole" | "fixed")
RecipeIngredient.description: An ingredient measured for RecipePlanner's baseGuests. scaling: proportional preserves fractions, whole rounds up whole items, fixed keeps quantity unchanged. Empty unit defaults to whole-item rounding; set proportional for fractions such as half an egg.

RecipeStep.signature: RecipeStep(time: string, title: string, description: string)
RecipeStep.description: A cooking checklist step. time is a relative or clock label such as '20 minutes before serving' or '6:30 PM'; title and description explain the action.

MenuDish.signature: MenuDish(name: string, description: string, imageUrl: string)
MenuDish.description: A dish card for RecipePlanner. imageUrl must be a real provided image URL or empty for a neutral illustrated plate. Do not invent images or reuse roast photos for unrelated recipes.

RecipePlanner.signature: RecipePlanner(title: string, description: string, baseGuests: number, ingredients: RecipeIngredient[], steps: RecipeStep[], dishes: MenuDish[], guests?: $binding<number>, maxGuests?: number, portionNote?: string, cookingNote?: string)
RecipePlanner.description: Compose any meal or menu from RecipeIngredient, RecipeStep and MenuDish refs. Quantities are measured for baseGuests and scale to an editable guest count. guests accepts a $state binding for linked controls. Optional notes explain portion and timing assumptions. Never substitute default roast ingredients for a custom meal.

WardrobePiece.signature: WardrobePiece(id: string, name: string, category: string, color: string, kind: "shirt" | "tee" | "jacket" | "trousers" | "shoes" | "bag" | "dress" | "skirt" | "shorts" | "hat" | "accessory", imageUrl?: string)
WardrobePiece.description: A garment or accessory. id is unique in its wardrobe; category is a free-form filter. kind selects a silhouette, and a real imageUrl can represent any item beyond those silhouettes. color is a hex color.

WardrobeOutfit.signature: WardrobeOutfit(name: string, occasion: string, itemIds: string[])
WardrobeOutfit.description: A named combination of WardrobePiece ids for any occasion. itemIds must match items in the same WardrobePlanner; categories, occasions and item counts are unrestricted within the bounds.

PackingRule.signature: PackingRule(weather: string, includeItemIds: string[], excludeItemIds: string[], note: string)
PackingRule.description: A declarative wardrobe packing rule. weather matches one of the planner's weatherOptions, or '*' applies always. Include or exclude existing item ids. Rules run in order; exclusions win within a rule. note explains the adjustment.

WardrobePlanner.signature: WardrobePlanner(title: string, description: string, items: WardrobePiece[], outfits: WardrobeOutfit[], weatherOptions?: string[], tripLengthOptions?: number[], defaultWeather?: string, defaultTripDays?: number, packingRules?: PackingRule[])
WardrobePlanner.description: Compose wardrobes from WardrobePiece and WardrobeOutfit refs. Category filters, favorites, outfit combinations and packing work for arbitrary supplied items. Optional weatherOptions, tripLengthOptions and PackingRule refs customize personalization; no clothing types or weather decisions are assumed for a custom wardrobe. Never invent prices or purchase links.

TripStop.signature: TripStop(day: number, name: string, region: string, category: string, wiki: string, lat: number, lng: number, description: string, stay: string, highlight: string)
TripStop.description: One day of a road trip in ANY region. Supply real coordinates and exact Wikipedia title for photos. Days should have unique numbers.

RoadTripPlanner.signature: RoadTripPlanner(title: string, days?: TripStop[], description?: string, region?: string, currency?: string, lodgingPerNight?: number, foodPerPersonDay?: number, transportPerDay?: number, transportFixed?: number, activitiesPerPerson?: number, seasonalAdvice?: Record<string, string>, travelNote?: string, initialPartySize?: number, initialSeason?: string, initialStyle?: "Budget-minded" | "Balanced" | "Comfort first", partySizes?: number[], seasonOptions?: string[])
RoadTripPlanner.description: Interactive itinerary for ANY destination and duration. Compose TripStop children, local currency, cost assumptions, seasonal advice and initialPartySize/initialSeason/initialStyle. partySizes and seasonOptions customize preference choices. Supply days for custom destinations; omitting days selects the reference only when title is exactly '10 days in the Pacific Northwest'.

ColorSwatch.description: Named color for a RecolorableScene palette.

ColorRegion.signature: ColorRegion(id: string, label: string, originalColor: string)
ColorRegion.description: Editable region of a scene. Match id to SceneShape.region to recolor all matching shapes together.

GuideStep.signature: GuideStep(title: string, body: string, tip?: string, illustration?: SceneDrawing, explodedIllustration?: SceneDrawing, find?: string, check?: string, id?: string)
GuideStep.description: One instruction in an IllustratedStepGuide or AssemblyGuide. Supply original SceneDrawing illustrations for this step; never use unrelated preset artwork. explodedIllustration optionally supplies an expanded parts view. find lists parts needed; check labels completion.

GridOption.signature: GridOption(id: string, name: string, color: string, short?: string, note?: string, ink?: string, icon?: string, tip?: string, illustration?: SceneDrawing, textColor?: string)
GridOption.description: An assignable item in EditableGrid: a plant, seat type, room use, task or material. id is referenced by GridLayout.cells.

GridLayout.signature: GridLayout(id: string, label: string, rows: number, columns: number, cells: string[], cellLabel?: string, summary?: string)
GridLayout.description: A rectangular editable layout. cells contains option IDs in row-major order, one per cell. Multiple layouts preserve independent edits.

RecolorableScene.signature: RecolorableScene(title: string, scene: SceneDrawing, palette: ColorSwatch[], regions: ColorRegion[], description?: string, footnote?: string, originalLabel?: string, selectedRegion?: $binding<string>, colors?: $binding<Record<string, string>>)
RecolorableScene.description: Recolor any original vector scene: rooms, furniture, clothing or product finishes. Compose SceneDrawing with region IDs, ColorRegion definitions and a ColorSwatch palette. Multiple regions recolor independently. colors and selectedRegion can bind to shared $variables.

IllustratedStepGuide.signature: IllustratedStepGuide(title: string, steps: GuideStep[], description?: string, level?: string, repeatLabel?: string, activeStep?: $binding<number>)
IllustratedStepGuide.description: Arbitrary illustrated instructions for folding, crafts, cooking, drawing or learning. Every step has model-supplied text and optional safe vector illustration. Includes progress, tips and previous/next controls. activeStep is zero-based and may bind to shared $state for external navigation.

EditableGrid.signature: EditableGrid(title: string, options: GridOption[], layouts: GridLayout[], description?: string, footnote?: string, footer?: string, optionLabel?: string, resetLabel?: string, selectedLayout?: $binding<string>, assignments?: $binding<Record<string, string[]>>)
EditableGrid.description: Editable rectangular planning grid with model-supplied dimensions, layouts, assignable options, colors and notes. Use for gardens, seating, floor plans, task boards or storage. assignments can bind shared $state as a map of layout ID to row-major option IDs; selectedLayout also supports shared state.

AssemblyGuide.signature: AssemblyGuide(title: string, steps: GuideStep[], description?: string, footnote?: string, activeStep?: $binding<number>)
AssemblyGuide.description: Step-by-step assembly or repair of any object. Supply GuideSteps with parts, instructions, completion checks, and original assembled/exploded SceneDrawing views. Any number of steps; activeStep may bind to shared $state.

RoomColorPreview.signature: RoomColorPreview(title: string, palette?: ColorSwatch[], regions?: ColorRegion[], scene?: SceneDrawing, description?: string)
RoomColorPreview.description: Living-room preset of RecolorableScene. Optional palette, regions and original scene allow custom interiors. For other objects use RecolorableScene.

OrigamiGuide.signature: OrigamiGuide(title: string, steps?: GuideStep[], description?: string, level?: string)
OrigamiGuide.description: Origami preset of IllustratedStepGuide. Default is the twelve-step fox; supply GuideSteps and their own illustrations for a different fold. Never change only the title to claim a different model.

GardenPlanner.signature: GardenPlanner(title: string, options?: GridOption[], layouts?: GridLayout[], description?: string, footer?: string)
GardenPlanner.description: Garden preset of EditableGrid. Supply plant GridOptions and any rectangular GridLayouts for a different garden. Defaults to four planters or sixteen squares.

BikeRepair.signature: BikeRepair(title: string, steps?: GuideStep[], description?: string, footnote?: string)
BikeRepair.description: Youth bicycle preset of AssemblyGuide. Optional GuideSteps replace instructions and artwork together. Use AssemblyGuide for other objects and supply matching scene illustrations.

SceneShape.signature: SceneShape(kind: "path" | "circle" | "ellipse" | "rect" | "line" | "text", d?: string, x?: number, y?: number, width?: number, height?: number, r?: number, x2?: number, y2?: number, fill?: string, stroke?: string, strokeWidth?: number, opacity?: number, text?: string, region?: string)
SceneShape.description: A safe vector shape used inside SceneDrawing or DiagramPart. Geometry is in scene coordinates. For paths use d; circles use x/y/r; ellipses use x/y/width/height as radii. Text uses text and height as font size.

SceneDrawing.description: A vector drawing composed of SceneShape records. Supply [minX,minY,width,height] and shapes. No SVG markup or JavaScript.

DiagramPart.signature: DiagramPart(id: string, label: string, group?: string, description?: string, shapes: SceneShape[], offset: any, pivot?: any, rotates?: boolean)
DiagramPart.description: One independently movable part of any object. Supply vector shapes, group, explanation, and explode offset. Wheels/rotors can have rotates=true and a pivot. Parts are data, never hardcoded to an object type.

ExplodedDiagram.signature: ExplodedDiagram(title: string, parts: DiagramPart[], viewBox?: any, description?: string, motionLabel?: string, showControls?: boolean, explode?: $binding<number>, selected?: $binding<string>, showHeading?: boolean)
ExplodedDiagram.description: Exploded view of ANY object: bicycle, unicycle, camera, engine, plant, etc. Compose DiagramPart and SceneShape records. Include margins in viewBox for fully exploded offsets. explode and selected can bind to shared $state; set showControls=false to compose external RangeControl/ChoiceControl.

RangeControl.signature: RangeControl(name: string, label: string, min: number, max: number, step?: number, value?: $binding<number>, unit?: string)
RangeControl.description: Composable scalar slider. Bind value to a $variable to control other components immediately (e.g. ExplodedDiagram.explode, ValueDisplay, Contribution.value). Same visual control as every example.

ChoiceControl.signature: ChoiceControl(name: string, label: string, options: string[], value?: $binding<string>)
ChoiceControl.description: A row of choices that reads/writes a shared $variable. Use with ExplodedDiagram.selected or any computed expression. Options must match the target IDs or groups.

ValueDisplay.signature: ValueDisplay(label: string, value: number, prefix?: string, suffix?: string, decimals?: number)
ValueDisplay.description: Live numeric result. value accepts a built-in OpenUI expression such as $quantity * $price; recalculates when inputs change.

Contribution.signature: Contribution(label: string, value: number, color: string, prefix?: string, suffix?: string)
Contribution.description: Labeled contribution to a total. value can be an OpenUI expression or $variable; signed values are supported.

ContributionChart.description: Proportional stacked bar for any composition: spending, energy, budgets, revenue. Use Contribution children whose values reference shared $variables. Handles deductions separately and keeps labels legible.

KnowledgeCheck.signature: KnowledgeCheck(question: string, options: string[], answer: number, explanation: string, value?: $binding<number>)
KnowledgeCheck.description: A reusable multiple-choice knowledge check. answer is the zero-based correct option index. Optional value can bind to shared state.

InteractivePanel.signature: InteractivePanel(title: string, children: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock | ListBlock | FollowUpBlock | SectionBlock | Tabs | Carousel | RouteMap | RouteStops | RouteSuggestions | BicycleExplorer | DistributionExplorer | EconomyExplorer | DroneExplorer | DroneMarket | MontyHall | RetroGame | BillLineItem | BillSplitter | SavingsCalculator | RecipeIngredient | RecipeStep | MenuDish | RecipePlanner | WardrobePiece | WardrobeOutfit | PackingRule | WardrobePlanner | TripStop | RoadTripPlanner | ColorSwatch | ColorRegion | GuideStep | GridOption | GridLayout | RecolorableScene | IllustratedStepGuide | EditableGrid | AssemblyGuide | RoomColorPreview | OrigamiGuide | GardenPlanner | BikeRepair | SceneShape | SceneDrawing | DiagramPart | ExplodedDiagram | RangeControl | ChoiceControl | ValueDisplay | Contribution | ContributionChart | KnowledgeCheck | InteractiveGroup)[], description?: string, badge?: string)
InteractivePanel.description: Polished panel for a custom interactive explanation or calculator. Compose independent RangeControl, ChoiceControl, ValueDisplay, ContributionChart, KnowledgeCheck and base library children. Connect them using shared $variables and built-in expressions. InteractiveGroup provides columns.

InteractiveGroup.signature: InteractiveGroup(children: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock | ListBlock | FollowUpBlock | SectionBlock | Tabs | Carousel | RouteMap | RouteStops | RouteSuggestions | BicycleExplorer | DistributionExplorer | EconomyExplorer | DroneExplorer | DroneMarket | MontyHall | RetroGame | BillLineItem | BillSplitter | SavingsCalculator | RecipeIngredient | RecipeStep | MenuDish | RecipePlanner | WardrobePiece | WardrobeOutfit | PackingRule | WardrobePlanner | TripStop | RoadTripPlanner | ColorSwatch | ColorRegion | GuideStep | GridOption | GridLayout | RecolorableScene | IllustratedStepGuide | EditableGrid | AssemblyGuide | RoomColorPreview | OrigamiGuide | GardenPlanner | BikeRepair | SceneShape | SceneDrawing | DiagramPart | ExplodedDiagram | RangeControl | ChoiceControl | ValueDisplay | Contribution | ContributionChart | KnowledgeCheck)[], columns?: "one" | "two" | "three")
InteractiveGroup.description: Compose controls, results, charts, text and illustrations into a responsive group. Use two columns for paired controls or metrics. All reactive children can share $variables.

componentGroups.name: Content
notes: - InlineHeader is a compact heading + description pair for labelling a block inside the response (lighter than CardHeader).

- Pass sources on Card ([{ title, sourceName, url }]) when the answer relies on references, and cite them inline in TextContent as [1], [2] (1-based index into sources). A Sources strip renders at the bottom of the card.

componentGroups.name: Tables
notes: - EditableTable lets the user edit cells inline. Give it a unique name, columns of { type, key, header } with type one of text | number | date-single | select | url (select also needs options: [{ value, label }]).
- data is an array of { id, values } rows where values are ordered positionally to match columns. Edited data is submitted when the user clicks Save Changes.

componentGroups.name: Forms
notes: - Chips: compact single/multiple selection pills. Use ChipItem references for each option.
- OptionCards: larger selectable cards with title, subtitle and an optional Icon or Image on top. Use OptionCard references for each option.
- Define EACH FormControl as its own reference — do NOT inline all controls in one array.
- NEVER nest Form inside Form.
- Form requires explicit buttons. Always pass a Buttons(...) reference as the second Form argument: Form(name, buttons, fields).
- rules is an optional object: { required: true, email: true, min: 8, maxLength: 100 }
- The renderer shows error messages automatically — do NOT generate error text in the UI

componentGroups.name: Buttons
notes: - Icon renders a lucide icon by kebab-case name; it is also used as the icon of IconButton, IconText and OptionCard.

componentGroups.name: Lists & Follow-ups
notes: - Use ListBlock with ListItem references for numbered lists.
- Use FollowUpBlock with FollowUpItem references at the end of a response to suggest next actions.
- A ListItem is clickable ONLY when given an action (5th argument); without one it is plain text.
- Clicking a FollowUpItem, or a ListItem with a continue_conversation action, sends text to the LLM as a user message.
- Example: list = ListBlock([item1, item2])  item1 = ListItem("Option A", "Details about A", null, null, { type: "continue_conversation", context: "Option A" })

componentGroups.name: Sections
notes: - SectionBlock renders collapsible accordion sections that auto-open as they stream.
- Each section needs a unique `value` id, a `trigger` label, and a `content` array.
- Example: sections = SectionBlock([s1, s2])  s1 = SectionItem("intro", "Introduction", [content1])
- Set isFoldable=false to render sections as flat headers instead of accordion.

componentGroups.name: Layout
notes: - Use Tabs to present alternative views — each TabItem has a value id, trigger label, and content array.
- Carousel takes an array of slides, where each slide is an array of content: carousel = Carousel([[t1, img1], [t2, img2]])
- IMPORTANT: Every slide in a Carousel must have the same structure — same component types in the same order.
- For image carousels use: [[title, image, description, tags], ...] — every slide must follow this exact pattern.
- Use real, publicly accessible image URLs (e.g. https://picsum.photos/seed/KEYWORD/800/500). Never hallucinate image URLs.

componentGroups.name: Data Display
notes: - EntityList is a compact two-column list of { left, right } rows (e.g. name / value). size='default' also supports a header and footer row; size='small' does not.

componentGroups.name: Cards
notes: - Card blocks lay out 2+ items in a responsive grid (or carousel where supported). Every item in a block must have the same structure.
- SnippetCardItem: small card with lhs (IconText | ImageText) and optional rhs (Text | BoldText) — good for key/value facts.
- OverviewCardItem: small card with top (IconText | ImageText | Text) and optional bottom MetricIndicatorInline — good for KPIs.
- ContextCardItem: medium card with a title (string or Tag), body text and optional background image — good for summaries.

- CompositeCardItem: rich card with header, body array (Text, BoldText, MetricIndicatorInline, IconText, Image, charts, ListBlock, TagBlock, EntityList) and footer (price + Button) — good for products/offers.
- VisualCardItem: image-first card with a BoldText body and optional Tag.
- Text / BoldText / IconText / ImageText / ImageTextLarge / MetricIndicator* are the inline building blocks used INSIDE card items; do not place them directly in the root Card.

componentGroups.name: Travel
notes: - For itineraries, day trips or sightseeing routes: CardHeader, then RouteMap([s1, s2, ...]), then RouteStops([s1, s2, ...]) using the same stop refs, then RouteSuggestions('Add to your day', [x1, x2]) with 2 extra stops not in the route, then an optional Callout with tips.

componentGroups.name: Composable intelligent UI
notes: Generate the data and compose components for the user's actual subject. Use ExplodedDiagram with arbitrary DiagramPart and SceneShape records for bicycles, unicycles, cameras or other objects; changing a title never changes geometry.
SceneDrawing is bounded vector data, not raw SVG markup or code. Provide original geometry, labels, offsets and a viewBox that includes every part at full expansion.
Bind reactive props to shared $variables. A RangeControl can drive ExplodedDiagram.explode, calculations and multiple outputs together. Prefer native expressions over hard-coded calculated results.
RecolorableScene, IllustratedStepGuide, AssemblyGuide and EditableGrid accept new scenes, regions, steps and dimensions. Never reuse unrelated example artwork.

componentGroups.name: Data-driven everyday tools
notes: Supply RecipeIngredient, RecipeStep and MenuDish records for any meal. Quantities relate to baseGuests. Supply new WardrobePiece, WardrobeOutfit and PackingRule records for a custom wardrobe.
BillLineItem.people contains zero-based person indices. SavingsCalculator is hypothetical compound growth. RoadTripPlanner accepts arbitrary TripStop records, currency and cost assumptions.
Omitted datasets select reference presets; always provide datasets for a different subject or location. Do not present invented budgets, scenarios or routes as verified live data.

componentGroups.name: Reference presets and specialized simulations
notes: These are bounded reference experiences: seven-speed bicycle, fox origami, living room, garden, youth-bike assembly, GDP and drone market. For a different subject compose the generic components above.
DistributionExplorer, MontyHall and RetroGame have purpose-built statistical/game mechanics. Do not imply they simulate arbitrary systems.

Card.description: Root response container. Compose clear text, visualizations, interactive tools and everyday planning components. Avoid redundant headings when an interactive component already has a title.

TextContent.description: Text block. Supports markdown. Optional size: "small" | "default" | "large" | "small-heavy" | "large-heavy".

MarkDownRenderer.description: Renders markdown text with optional container variant

CardHeader.description: Header with optional title and subtitle

Callout.description: Callout banner. Optional visible is a reactive $boolean — auto-dismisses after 3s by setting $visible to false.

TextCallout.description: Text callout with variant, title, and description

Image.description: Image with alt text and optional URL

ImageGallery.description: Gallery grid of images with modal preview

HorizontalBarChart.description: Horizontal bars; prefer when category labels are long or for ranked lists

RadarChart.description: Spider/web chart; use for comparing multiple variables across one or more entities

PieChart.description: Circular slices; use plucked arrays: PieChart(data.categories, data.values)

RadialChart.description: Radial bars; use plucked arrays: RadialChart(data.categories, data.values)

SingleStackedBarChart.description: Single horizontal stacked bar; use plucked arrays: SingleStackedBarChart(data.categories, data.values)

ScatterChart.description: X/Y scatter plot; use for correlations, distributions, and clustering

AreaChart.description: Filled area under lines; use for cumulative totals or volume trends over time

BarChart.description: Vertical bars; use for comparing values across categories with one or more series

LineChart.description: Lines over categories; use for trends and continuous data over time

Table.description: Data table — column-oriented. Each Col holds its own data array.

Col.description: Column definition — holds label + data array

TagBlock.description: tags is an array of strings; optional size sm | md | lg

Form.description: Form container with fields and explicit action buttons

FormControl.description: Field with label, input component, and optional hint text

Slider.description: Numeric slider input; supports continuous and discrete (stepped) variants

Chips.description: A form field of compact selectable chips for choosing one or many short options; the selection is stored under `name`.

ChipItem.description: A single selectable chip inside a Chips group, with a value, label and optional icon.

Icon.description: A lucide icon by kebab-case name (e.g. 'circle-check'). Optional category picks a topical fallback when the name doesn't resolve.

OptionCards.description: A form field of selectable cards (title, optional subtitle, optional icon or image) laid out in a responsive grid for choosing one or many options; the selection is stored under `name`.

OptionCard.description: A single selectable card inside an OptionCards group, with a value, title, optional subtitle and an optional Icon or Image on top.

IconButton.description: Icon-only button. name is the accessible label and the action label; icon is an Icon; action fires on click.

StepsItem.description: title and details text for one step

InlineHeader.description: Compact section heading with an optional one-line description, for use inside cards.

EntityList.description: Two-column key/value rows (left label, right value). size 'default' supports optional header and footer rows; rightVariant 'number' uses tabular numbers.

EditableTable.description: Spreadsheet-like table whose cells the user can edit inline (text, number, url, date, select columns); edits are saved back as a form field

SnippetCardBlock.description: A responsive grid of compact label/value cards (2 per row) for showing several short facts side by side; optionally clickable with a shared action.

SnippetCardItem.description: One row-style snippet card: a label on the left (IconText or ImageText) and an optional value on the right (Text or BoldText).

IconText.description: An icon badge with a title and optional subtitle, laid out horizontally or vertically. iconVariant sets the badge color.

ImageText.description: A small square image (thumbnail/avatar) with a title and optional subtitle. src must be a real image URL.

Text.description: Plain text line with optional subtext. variant 'number' uses tabular number styling; subtextVariant 'metric' colors a leading +/- subtext green/red.

BoldText.description: Emphasized (bold) text line with optional subtext. variant 'number' uses tabular number styling; subtextVariant 'metric' colors a leading +/- subtext green/red.

OverviewCardBlock.description: A grid or horizontal carousel of compact overview cards, each with a heading (icon/image/text) on top and an inline metric below; optionally clickable with a shared action.

OverviewCardItem.description: One overview card: a heading slot at the top (IconText, ImageText or Text) and an optional MetricIndicatorInline at the bottom.

MetricIndicatorInline.description: Headline metric value with an optional +/- percentage trend and subtext, all on one line.

ContextCardBlock.description: A grid or carousel of compact tinted context cards (title or tag plus a short bold body); an optional action makes every card clickable.

ContextCardItem.description: A single card inside a ContextCardBlock: a title (plain string or Tag), an optional markdown body, and an optional gray tint or background image.

Tag.description: Styled tag/badge with optional Icon and variant

CompositeCardBlock.description: A two-per-row grid or carousel of rich cards, each with an optional header, stacked body content (text, metrics, charts, lists, tags) and a price/button footer; an optional action makes every card clickable.

CompositeCardItem.description: A single card inside a CompositeCardBlock: an optional header (icon/image/text), a stack of body elements (text, metrics, charts, lists, tags), and an optional price/button footer.

ImageTextLarge.description: A full-width banner image above a bold title and optional subtitle. src must be a real image URL.

ListBlock.description: A list of items with number or image indicators. Each item can optionally have an action. size small renders a compact list.

ListItem.description: Item in a ListBlock — displays a title with an optional subtitle and image. When action is provided, the item becomes clickable.

MetricIndicatorWithStrikethrough.description: Headline metric value with an optional struck-through previousValue, a +/- percentage trend, and subtext below.

VisualCardBlock.description: A grid or carousel of photo-first cards: a full-bleed background image with a tag on top and a bold text panel at the bottom; an optional action makes every card clickable.

VisualCardItem.description: A single photo-first card inside a VisualCardBlock: a BoldText body panel, an optional Tag, and a background image (bgImageSrc must be a real URL; bgImageAlt is its alt text).

FollowUpBlock.description: List of clickable follow-up suggestions placed at the end of a response

FollowUpItem.description: Clickable follow-up suggestion — when clicked, sends text as user message

SectionBlock.description: Collapsible accordion sections. Auto-opens sections as they stream in. Use SectionItem for each section.

SectionItem.description: Section with a label and collapsible content — used inside SectionBlock

TabItem.description: value is unique id, trigger is tab label, content is array of components

AccordionItem.description: value is unique id, trigger is section title

RouteMap.description: Interactive map that plots RouteStop items in visiting order with a walking path. Always reuse the SAME RouteStop references in RouteStops below it.

RouteStop.description: One stop on a route. wikiTitle is the exact English Wikipedia article title (used to load real photos). lat/lng are decimal coordinates. time e.g. '9:00 · 1 hr'. story: 1-2 sentences of history. beforeYouGo: one practical tip. Optional category groups the map, e.g. 'Landmarks', 'Museums' or 'Neighborhoods'. Optional id distinguishes repeated visits or stops with identical names in a route.

RouteStops.description: Photo cards for each RouteStop (real photos, story, tips, remove-from-route toggle).

RouteSuggestions.description: Optional extra stops the user can add to the route with one tap (adds a pin to RouteMap and a card to RouteStops). Use 2 stops that are NOT already in the route.

BicycleExplorer.description: Interactive side-view seven-speed bicycle with selectable Frame, Wheels, Drivetrain, Brakes and Cockpit systems, explanations and moving pedals. Use for explaining bicycle mechanics.

DistributionExplorer.description: Interactive central limit theorem simulation with sample size, population distributions, live histograms and sampling controls. Use for explaining statistics and the CLT.

EconomyExplorer.description: Interactive GDP explainer with adjustable consumer spending, investment, government spending and net exports. Values are illustrative, not current economic data.

DroneExplorer.description: Interactive drone photography composition explainer: camera tilt, altitude, illustrated landscape and thirds grid.

DroneMarket.description: Interactive drone photography market overview with photo categories, illustrative growth chart, comparison KPIs, revenue sliders and business table. Example figures are not live market data.

MontyHall.description: Playable Monty Hall probability demonstration. Pick one of three doors, switch or stay, and simulate 1000 games.

RetroGame.description: Playable retro handheld console with Snake, Breakout and Pong, real collision physics, scoring, keyboard and touch directional controls, pause and restart. game selects the initial game. Retro beige handheld housing and green pixel screen.

BillLineItem.description: An expense for BillSplitter. amount is in the selected currency's main unit. people contains zero-based indexes into the splitter's people array; assign at least one person when splitting by item.

BillSplitter.description: Compose editable bills, trips or shared expenses from BillLineItem refs and named people. Currency-aware exact splitting, per-item or equal allocation, editable tax/tip and copyable shares. taxPercent and tipPercent accept $state bindings so controls can share state with the response. Optional labels adapt the copy to the expense type.

SavingsCalculator.description: A configurable projection for any savings goal, currency, balance, monthly deposit and horizon. Numeric inputs accept $state bindings. Calculates monthly compounding with optional start/end-of-month deposits and an annual contribution increase. Includes zero and negative return scenarios; hypothetical projections are not guaranteed.

RecipeIngredient.description: An ingredient measured for RecipePlanner's baseGuests. scaling: proportional preserves fractions, whole rounds up whole items, fixed keeps quantity unchanged. Empty unit defaults to whole-item rounding; set proportional for fractions such as half an egg.

RecipeStep.description: A cooking checklist step. time is a relative or clock label such as '20 minutes before serving' or '6:30 PM'; title and description explain the action.

MenuDish.description: A dish card for RecipePlanner. imageUrl must be a real provided image URL or empty for a neutral illustrated plate. Do not invent images or reuse roast photos for unrelated recipes.

RecipePlanner.description: Compose any meal or menu from RecipeIngredient, RecipeStep and MenuDish refs. Quantities are measured for baseGuests and scale to an editable guest count. guests accepts a $state binding for linked controls. Optional notes explain portion and timing assumptions. Never substitute default roast ingredients for a custom meal.

WardrobePiece.description: A garment or accessory. id is unique in its wardrobe; category is a free-form filter. kind selects a silhouette, and a real imageUrl can represent any item beyond those silhouettes. color is a hex color.

WardrobeOutfit.description: A named combination of WardrobePiece ids for any occasion. itemIds must match items in the same WardrobePlanner; categories, occasions and item counts are unrestricted within the bounds.

PackingRule.description: A declarative wardrobe packing rule. weather matches one of the planner's weatherOptions, or '*' applies always. Include or exclude existing item ids. Rules run in order; exclusions win within a rule. note explains the adjustment.

WardrobePlanner.description: Compose wardrobes from WardrobePiece and WardrobeOutfit refs. Category filters, favorites, outfit combinations and packing work for arbitrary supplied items. Optional weatherOptions, tripLengthOptions and PackingRule refs customize personalization; no clothing types or weather decisions are assumed for a custom wardrobe. Never invent prices or purchase links.

TripStop.description: One day of a road trip in ANY region. Supply real coordinates and exact Wikipedia title for photos. Days should have unique numbers.

RoadTripPlanner.description: Interactive itinerary for ANY destination and duration. Compose TripStop children, local currency, cost assumptions, seasonal advice and initialPartySize/initialSeason/initialStyle. partySizes and seasonOptions customize preference choices. Supply days for custom destinations; omitting days selects the reference only when title is exactly '10 days in the Pacific Northwest'.

ColorSwatch.description: Named color for a RecolorableScene palette.

ColorRegion.description: Editable region of a scene. Match id to SceneShape.region to recolor all matching shapes together.

GuideStep.description: One instruction in an IllustratedStepGuide or AssemblyGuide. Supply original SceneDrawing illustrations for this step; never use unrelated preset artwork. explodedIllustration optionally supplies an expanded parts view. find lists parts needed; check labels completion.

SceneDrawing.description: A vector drawing composed of SceneShape records. Supply [minX,minY,width,height] and shapes. No SVG markup or JavaScript.

SceneShape.description: A safe vector shape used inside SceneDrawing or DiagramPart. Geometry is in scene coordinates. For paths use d; circles use x/y/r; ellipses use x/y/width/height as radii. Text uses text and height as font size.

GridOption.description: An assignable item in EditableGrid: a plant, seat type, room use, task or material. id is referenced by GridLayout.cells.

GridLayout.description: A rectangular editable layout. cells contains option IDs in row-major order, one per cell. Multiple layouts preserve independent edits.

RecolorableScene.description: Recolor any original vector scene: rooms, furniture, clothing or product finishes. Compose SceneDrawing with region IDs, ColorRegion definitions and a ColorSwatch palette. Multiple regions recolor independently. colors and selectedRegion can bind to shared $variables.

IllustratedStepGuide.description: Arbitrary illustrated instructions for folding, crafts, cooking, drawing or learning. Every step has model-supplied text and optional safe vector illustration. Includes progress, tips and previous/next controls. activeStep is zero-based and may bind to shared $state for external navigation.

EditableGrid.description: Editable rectangular planning grid with model-supplied dimensions, layouts, assignable options, colors and notes. Use for gardens, seating, floor plans, task boards or storage. assignments can bind shared $state as a map of layout ID to row-major option IDs; selectedLayout also supports shared state.

AssemblyGuide.description: Step-by-step assembly or repair of any object. Supply GuideSteps with parts, instructions, completion checks, and original assembled/exploded SceneDrawing views. Any number of steps; activeStep may bind to shared $state.

RoomColorPreview.description: Living-room preset of RecolorableScene. Optional palette, regions and original scene allow custom interiors. For other objects use RecolorableScene.

OrigamiGuide.description: Origami preset of IllustratedStepGuide. Default is the twelve-step fox; supply GuideSteps and their own illustrations for a different fold. Never change only the title to claim a different model.

GardenPlanner.description: Garden preset of EditableGrid. Supply plant GridOptions and any rectangular GridLayouts for a different garden. Defaults to four planters or sixteen squares.

BikeRepair.description: Youth bicycle preset of AssemblyGuide. Optional GuideSteps replace instructions and artwork together. Use AssemblyGuide for other objects and supply matching scene illustrations.

DiagramPart.description: One independently movable part of any object. Supply vector shapes, group, explanation, and explode offset. Wheels/rotors can have rotates=true and a pivot. Parts are data, never hardcoded to an object type.

ExplodedDiagram.description: Exploded view of ANY object: bicycle, unicycle, camera, engine, plant, etc. Compose DiagramPart and SceneShape records. Include margins in viewBox for fully exploded offsets. explode and selected can bind to shared $state; set showControls=false to compose external RangeControl/ChoiceControl.

RangeControl.description: Composable scalar slider. Bind value to a $variable to control other components immediately (e.g. ExplodedDiagram.explode, ValueDisplay, Contribution.value). Same visual control as every example.

ChoiceControl.description: A row of choices that reads/writes a shared $variable. Use with ExplodedDiagram.selected or any computed expression. Options must match the target IDs or groups.

ValueDisplay.description: Live numeric result. value accepts a built-in OpenUI expression such as $quantity * $price; recalculates when inputs change.

Contribution.description: Labeled contribution to a total. value can be an OpenUI expression or $variable; signed values are supported.

ContributionChart.description: Proportional stacked bar for any composition: spending, energy, budgets, revenue. Use Contribution children whose values reference shared $variables. Handles deductions separately and keeps labels legible.

KnowledgeCheck.description: A reusable multiple-choice knowledge check. answer is the zero-based correct option index. Optional value can bind to shared state.

InteractivePanel.description: Polished panel for a custom interactive explanation or calculator. Compose independent RangeControl, ChoiceControl, ValueDisplay, ContributionChart, KnowledgeCheck and base library children. Connect them using shared $variables and built-in expressions. InteractiveGroup provides columns.

InteractiveGroup.description: Compose controls, results, charts, text and illustrations into a responsive group. Use two columns for paired controls or metrics. All reactive children can share $variables.

Slice.description: One slice with label and numeric value
